name: duopore-public-education-deadline-planner
description: See when to start gathering documents for your study application deadlines.

interface.longDescription: See when to start gathering documents for your study application deadlines. Enter each deadline, which documents are ready, how long unfinished ones may take, and your buffer days. Get a start date and missing-document list. For adults planning their own applications. The app uses your dates; it does not check schools, decide admission or send reminders.
defaultPrompt: Work backwards from these study application deadlines.
Which application documents should I start preparing now?
